item.title: Emoji Use in the Electronic Health Record is Increasing
Ask HN: Claude Opus performance affected by time of day?
item.description:
📝 I've noticed recently that when I am using Opus at night (Eastern US), I am seeing it go down extreme rabbit holes on the same types of requests I am putting through on a regular basis. A request that would normally take 3-4 minutes will turn into a 10 minute adventure before I revert the changes, call out the mistake, and try again. I haven't performed a like for like test and that would be interesting, but has anyone else noticed the same.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46648900
